purpose: Teach: 東方/長寿/祈願/武術/癒す/ユートピア/迷信/懐中

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが東方神起のコンサート映像を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart, your dad's in there watching a Tohoshinki concert video.
lines.style: Soft amused aside to her son, low conspiratorial volume, a smile warming the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと長寿祝いのお赤飯食べたよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Dad ate the red celebration rice from the long-life party.
lines.style: Small proud voice, quick eager start then careful wording, a bright little finish.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが学業成就を神社で祈願されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went to the shrine and prayed for your studies to go well.
lines.style: Gentle telling-a-secret warmth, unhurried, tenderness rising on the mention of the prayer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと武術の演武会観たよ
lines.en: Mama, I watched the martial arts show with Dad!
lines.style: Breathy rush of excitement, words tumbling slightly, awed emphasis on the show.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「家族の存在が心を癒す」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said something lovely — 'just having this family heals the heart.'
lines.style: Slow moved delivery, softening into the quote, letting the sweetness sit at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとユートピア社会の社会科の話したよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Dad talked about utopia societies — it's from social studies.
lines.style: Earnest careful pronunciation of the big word, small thinking pause, a pleased little ending.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「迷信に振り回されないで」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad also said, 'don't let superstitions push you around.'
lines.style: Light instructive tone wrapped in warmth, gently mimicking Dad's voice on the quote.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんから祖父の遺品の懐中時計を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad gave me the pocket watch that was Grandpa's — his keepsake.
lines.style: Hushed, almost reverent for a six-year-old, slow careful words holding something precious.
